ResearchProjectDef.label: replicator study
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study block-Replicator architecture and controller-domain behavior closely enough to reuse recovered command fragments safely.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nanite analysis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Formalise the coordinated microscopic-machine principles observed in human-form Replicators and Asuran-derived technology.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran collective systems
ResearchProjectDef.description: Formalise distributed nanite identity and local peer coordination into engineered control architecture.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Asuran fabrication
ResearchProjectDef.description: Reconstruct the precision fabrication methods needed to manufacture stable Asuran-derived devices.

ResearchProjectDef.label: sovereign neural lattice control
ResearchProjectDef.description: Combine Asuran collective-control theory with studied Replicator domains to fabricate a bounded physical neural controller lattice. The implant grants multi-unit target-specific authority without conferring Queen identity.
